title: ALMA Observations of the Molecular Gas in the Elliptical Galaxy NGC 3557
question: What are the distribution, kinematics, mass, stability and CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) excitation of the molecular gas in the elliptical galaxy NGC 3557, and how do they relate to the radio jet and dust?

data.sensitivity: 3mm continuum 26 uJy/beam; CO(1-0) 0.8 mJy/beam at 20 km/s

what.value: Effective ellipticity 0.251 and effective radius 14" from K-band photometry

evidence.quote: The K-band photometry published in (cite: pah99) gives an effective ellipticity of $\epsilon_{e}$ = 0.251 for this object.

what.value: Stellar spectroscopy used to derive lambda_Re = 0.7

evidence.quote: could be derived from the long-slit stellar spectroscopy along the major axis of this galaxy in (cite: bro07), obtaining $\lambda_{Re}$ $=$ 0.7

what.value: Single-dish CO(2-1) mass of NGC 3557, log(MH2)=9.02

evidence.quote: These numbers differ quite significantly from those reported in (cite: pra10), i.e. log(M$_{H_2}$\[M$_\odot$\]) = 9.02.

recipe.goal: Recalibrate and combine two configurations, image
recipe.method: Recalibrate in CASA 4.5.1, uvcontsub on lines before concat, clean with Briggs weighting; cubes at 5,10,20,40 km/s
Compare 3 mm with 1 mm archival continuum on images smoothed to CO(1-0) resolution; same regions
Integrated CO(1-0) flux converted with standard X_CO; times 1.36 for helium
assumptions: X_CO≈2.8e20 cm^-2 (K km/s)^-1; distance 40 Mpc; helium factor 1.36

recipe.goal: Rotation curve fit and non-circular motions
recipe.method: 3DBAROLO tilted-ring fits to CO(1-0) and CO(2-1); model first-moment subtracted from observed in CASA
key_parameters: Data binned to 40 km/s; initial dispersion tested 10-40 km/s

recipe.method: Ring-averaged MOM0 converted to surface density, compared to critical density from kappa and sigma
assumptions: Gas in an inclined disk with inclination from 3DBAROLO

recipe.goal: CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) ratio map and excitation modeling
recipe.method: Beam-matched moment-0 ratio with immath divided by 4; compared to LVG and PDR models

evidence.quote: The total integrated CO(1-0) flux is 4.5$\pm$0.9 Jy km s$^{-1}$
the ALMA CO(2-1) data gives an integrated flux of 7.5$\pm$0.3 Jy km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: Systemic velocity, inclination, PA receding side

evidence.quote: systematic velocity v$_{sys}$ of 3019 km s$^{-1}$, an inclination of 51$\ensuremath{^\circ}$, a PA of the major axis on the receding side of 232$\ensuremath{^\circ}$
The average value of the ratio in the inner 1.5 arcsec is in fact 0.71$\pm$0.13[^12]
The peak departures from pure rotation are of +61 km s$^{-1}$ (NE Peak) and +28 km s$^{-1}$ (SW Peak)

not_stated_but_needed: Whether the clean masks, cleaning thresholds and number of iterations were used
Self-calibration solution intervals and number of rounds
Image size and exact velocity range/channel definitions for moment maps
3DBAROLO input parameters (rings, radial separation, masks, free/fixed parameters, initial guesses)
Exact LVG/PDR model grids and parameters
Reduction and calibration of the CO(2-1) archival data
IRAS 24 um flux value used for SFR
score_reason: Data are public and the pipeline is outlined, but imaging and fitting details are incomplete.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results (flux, mass, ratios, rotation parameters), and an outlined recipe.
